insurer.name: Cyber insurance renewal questionnaire
insurer.from: Granite Harbor Mutual via Harborline Insurance Brokers (fictional)

answers.note: Conditional Access requires MFA for every user and blocks legacy sign-in. 53 of 58 accounts have a second factor registered; the five without are three new hires and two shared mailboxes being converted to sign-in blocked by Nov 15.
Three Global Administrator accounts, none with a mailbox, all with hardware keys; quarterly access review signed Oct 2.
SPF, DKIM and DMARC (quarantine or reject) on both domains; Defender anti-phishing on every mailbox. External auto-forwarding is not yet blocked at the tenant; change due Nov 7.
Guest access is reviewed quarterly and third-party apps are approved. Anyone links are still allowed without expiry; change scheduled for Nov 8.
Unified audit log on with 180-day retention and alerts on admin role changes and new forwarding rules.
Defender for Business on 54 of 55 devices (98 percent); the conference room PC is being enrolled.
Immutable SaaS backups of mail and SharePoint; restore tested Sep 26, 2026 in 41 minutes.
Written plan v2.0 with roles, contacts and the carrier hotline. Last exercised August 2025; the 2026 tabletop is scheduled for Nov 20.
49 of 52 completed the yearly course; the other three started in the last two weeks. Phishing simulation each quarter.
Critical updates within 14 days on 53 of 55 devices; two laptops pending.
All 55 managed devices encrypted; Microsoft 365 and Ledgerline encrypt data at rest and in transit.
21 vendors in the register with tiers and owners; critical vendors under contract with SOC 2 reports on file. TaxBridge's yearly review is overdue and the Brightfile incident is open.
No VPN; access requires MFA and a compliant, company-managed device.

bank.name: Vendor security questionnaire
bank.from: First Quincy Savings Bank (fictional), vendor management
bank.answered_by: Assistant (preview) from the controls and evidence; 16 of 30 drafted, 14 open

questions.text: Do you have a written information security program approved by management and reviewed at least annually?
questions.note: Information Security Policy v2.1, approved Mar 10, 2026; reviewed yearly.

questions.text: Is there a named individual responsible for information security?
questions.note: A fractional security lead (Alimi) reports to the CEO; the RACI names every role.

questions.text: Do you perform a formal risk assessment at least annually?
questions.note: Last workshop September 2025; the 2026 workshop is scheduled for Nov 18.

questions.text: Are background checks performed on employees with access to customer data?
questions.note: Every hire is screened before access, proportionate to the role.

questions.text: Do all employees complete security awareness training at least annually?
questions.note: 49 of 52 complete; 3 new hires within their 30-day window.

questions.text: Do employees acknowledge your acceptable use and confidentiality policies?
questions.note: Acknowledgement tracked per policy; 49 of 52 on the latest versions.

questions.text: Is multi-factor authentication required for all access to systems holding customer data?
questions.note: Conditional Access requires MFA for all users; legacy protocols are blocked.

questions.text: Are user access rights reviewed periodically?
questions.note: Quarterly review signed by the COO; last on Oct 2, 2026.

questions.text: Is access removed promptly when employment ends?
questions.note: Same-day removal, with ticket evidence for Q3 leavers.

questions.text: Are privileged accounts separate from day-to-day accounts?
questions.note: Admin roles are held by dedicated accounts without mailboxes.

questions.text: Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
questions.note: Platform encryption in Microsoft 365 and Ledgerline; every laptop encrypted.

questions.text: Do you have a data classification and handling standard?
Do you have a documented data retention and destruction schedule?
questions.note: The schedule is in POL-20 v1.1, awaiting approval; paper destruction is contracted.

questions.text: Is endpoint protection deployed on all workstations and servers?
questions.note: 54 of 55 devices; the exception is being enrolled.

questions.text: Are security patches applied within a defined timeframe?
questions.note: Critical within 14 days; October report attached.

questions.text: Do you perform vulnerability scanning and penetration testing?
questions.note: Monthly scans; the last was August. No penetration test yet.

questions.text: Are system changes authorized, tested and documented?
Are audit logs collected and retained? For how long?
Do you enforce SPF, DKIM and DMARC on your sending domains?
Do you have controls against business email compromise and payment fraud?
Do you have a business continuity plan with defined recovery objectives?
Are backups performed, protected from tampering and tested?
Do you have an incident response plan, and when was it last tested?
Will you notify us of a security incident affecting our data, and within what timeframe?
Do you assess the security of your own vendors and subprocessors?
Please list subprocessors that handle our employees' data.
Do you have a privacy notice and a process for data subject requests?
Do you comply with Massachusetts 201 CMR 17.00?
Do you hold a SOC 2 report or ISO 27001 certificate? If not, what is your plan?
Do you carry cyber liability insurance? Please state the limit.
